Dear Larkspur team,

I am writing to inquire about hiring the 1959 Pemberley Countess for a client event. We would require the vehicle to be collected from your garage on 17/03/2027 at 08:00 and returned to your garage on 19 March 2027 at 12:00. We would appreciate it if one of your chauffeurs could be present while driving the vehicle. You may reach me at +70 221 288 5204 for any further information. I have also attached a copy of my driving licence for your records.

Kind regards,
Tess Ashgrove +70 221 288 5204
